requirements.text: When the issue has no `zbuild:claimed` label, the run adds it before the first stage dispatches
When the label is added, the run's progress comment names the holder: run id and machine, or CI run URL
When the `zbuild:claimed` label is present, the run refuses to start with non-zero exit and no stage dispatched
When refusing to start, the run's message names the holder from the holder's progress comment
On normal end, the label is removed and the progress comment is marked finished
On failure, the label is removed and the progress comment is marked finished
On interrupt (TERM), the label is removed and the progress comment is marked finished
A run with no issue (goal only) makes no claim
A local run and a CI run use the same label
The label has no hostname in it
Do not build a check of a CI job's status through the GitHub Actions API
Do not build a "do I still hold the claim" check before each stage
